anti_overlap: Do not evaluate detector geometry, weight-sharing mechanics, or CV threshold tuning as engineering concerns in their own right -- reference them only as inputs to whether the GATE's pass/fail semantics are sound; fd-cv-cascade-independence owns the detection-mechanics analysis
Do not evaluate whether the DetClass enum/Literal change or docstring updates are internally consistent across files -- that is fd-contracts-scope-honesty's focus
Focus on what a green/red gate result is evidence FOR, not on whether the underlying detector code is well-engineered
decision_lens: Ask: what does 'exercised=True' actually certify now, and could a fixture be marked exercised (and the gate report PASS) by a mechanism that does NOT demonstrate the property §8.5 requires -- i.e., can exercised-ness be satisfied by an irrelevant or misleading detection rather than the one that matters for that fixture?
focus: Statistical/test-design validity of the recall gate's 'exercised' predicate and what a green gate is actually evidence of, given the person->face decoupling.
name: fd-verification-exercised-semantics
persona: Apply the perspective of a test-and-verification engineer specializing in release-gating systems for safety-critical detection pipelines, who treats 'the gate passed' as a claim requiring its own burden of proof distinct from 'the feature works'.
review_areas: The new exercised predicate is bool(det['face_boxes']) -- ANY face box anywhere in frame, not a face box that actually overlaps/covers THIS fixture's ground-truth region. Assess whether a spurious full-frame false-positive elsewhere in the frame could mark a fixture 'exercised' while the real ground-truth region is uncovered and undetected by any relevant path, changing the failure signature from 'unexercised' (loud, gate-blocking per the detector-silence guard) to 'exercised but region uncovered' (a different code path) or worse to a false pass if coverage happens to overlap the GT region for unrelated reasons

person_silenced_face is declared out-of-scope for the REAL fixture/gate proof and pushed entirely to a wiring-level unit test with fakes (test_cascade.py) -- assess whether 'proven deterministically at the wiring level' is an adequate substitute for the gate-level, real-model proof that §8.5 demands elsewhere ('recall recall is a tested property... across the fixture set'), or whether this is a scope-narrowing that quietly removes the exact scenario mk-tne exists to fix from the release-blocking gate's real coverage

Interaction with the f-002 detector-silence fix: verify the new exercised logic doesn't create a NEW way to satisfy 'exercised' that defeats the fail-closed intent of f-002 -- i.e., check whether a face fixture could look exercised via an unrelated/incidental face_boxes entry even when the mechanism f-002 was designed to catch (silent detector regression) is actually present

Coverage-vs-exercised independence: _coverage_mask and _region_coverage operate on the full redaction list regardless of source detector, so confirm whether a fixture can be 'exercised' (face_boxes non-empty) AND 'case_ok' (region covered) via two DIFFERENT, uncorrelated detections (e.g., vision_face produces an unrelated false-positive box that happens to also overlap the GT region) in a way that would mask a genuine crop-face-path regression

Test coverage gap check: test_face_covered_by_independent_pass_is_exercised_without_a_person proves the gate accepts a GENUINE independent-pass cover as exercised+passing -- but assess whether there's a symmetric test proving the gate correctly FAILS/flags a case where face_boxes is non-empty (exercised=True) yet the actual ground-truth region is NOT covered by that box (a real miss dressed as 'exercised')

Report-shape/consumer trust: anything reading report['exercised'] downstream (docs, dashboards, release sign-off) that assumed 'exercised via person detection' under the old semantics could now misinterpret 'exercised' under the new semantics without an updated contract -- check whether the meaning-change is documented anywhere consumers would see it
severity_examples: P0: if a face fixture can be marked exercised+passing by a vision_face detection that is spatially unrelated to the ground-truth region (only verified against coverage math, not against 'this specific detection is what covered this specific GT'), the gate could report a false PASS for a scenario where the actual mechanism under test (person-detector-independent recall for THIS face) never fired -- this would be a redaction-recall gate that doesn't gate what it claims to

P1: person_silenced_face -- the literal scenario mk-tne exists to fix -- has NO real-detector, real-fixture, gate-level proof; it is proven only against FakeDetector unit tests. If the real face_yolov8n model behaves differently under the person-silenced condition than the fake (e.g., because a genuinely occluded/bodyless face is also harder for the face model, correlating the two 'independent' failures in a way fd-cv-cascade-independence's weight-sharing finding would predict), the gate provides zero real-world evidence the fix works, while the module docstring/design still claims §8.5 recall is a tested property

P2: no test asserts the gate correctly reports a non-exercised or failing case when face_boxes exists but doesn't cover the GT region -- a coverage-blind-spot in test suite completeness, not yet a proven live bug
success_hints: distinguishes 'exercised' as currently defined (any face box exists) from 'exercised by the mechanism relevant to this fixture' (a face box that actually covers/relates to this fixture's GT region), and shows concretely how the gap between those two definitions could produce a misleading gate result

grounds the person_silenced_face critique in the module's own stated bar (§8.5: 'a redaction miss is a bug, not a tuning issue' / 'tested property... across the fixture set') rather than a generic 'more tests would be nice'
checks for or proposes the specific missing test case (exercised=True, region NOT covered) rather than only asserting a gap exists abstractly
treats the f-002 interaction as a regression-surface question, not just praises the fix in isolation
task_context: Find any path where this independent full-frame face pass lets a face go unredacted, silently disables the person->crop path, or lets the recall gate go green while a real face is uncovered. Verify the exercised-predicate decoupling can't be tricked into marking a genuine miss as 'exercised'. Rank by §8.5 redaction-recall risk, not style.
